current_bottleneck: Native browser is read-only; corporate orders and private wallet data have no authenticated service boundary.
causal_hypothesis: A corporate-owned, certificate-pinned TLS RPC can enqueue existing signed mandates and return canonical private balances without handing corporate data to the market/public API.
single_intended_change: Route four signed orders through separate owner-only corporate API containers into existing dispatch workers; expose read-only canonical wallet snapshots and queue state.
baseline: R17 actual four-order HTTP-depth scenario: 2 fills/7500, 4 HTTP snapshots, 6 failure checks, zero post-match participant signatures.
most_likely_prediction_error: Owner-only service or canonical wallet generation checks could reject valid requests during concurrent worker advancement.
rejection_rules: Any original native financial/HTTP gate fails
Cross-corporate credential reads a wallet or queue
Wrong or regressing canonical wallet snapshot reported as current
promotion_rules: smoke_only; inspect real queue/wallet artifacts and credential boundary separately before acceptance; no production or browser corporate UI claim
command: make remote-native-http-e2e REMOTE_TEST_HOST=softbank-l40s REMOTE_TEST_SSH_OPTIONS='-o BatchMode=yes -o ProxyJump=none' NATIVE_HTTP_MANIFEST=/research/manifests/oclob_native_http_005.json NATIVE_CORPORATE_API=1
